notes.title: Demo Release — Unsealed Pact is Now Playable!
notes.content:
The pact has been unsealed!

We’re excited to announce that the free demo of Unsealed Pact is now available to play on Steam. This is your first chance to dive into the world we’ve been building and experience the game’s unique twist on roguelike deckbuilding.


What’s inside the demo:


[]🧙 1 Hero — experiment with their unique playstyle
[]⚔️ 2 Acts — battle through branching paths and encounters
🃏 Deck, Relics & Summons — the core systems are ready to test


This is just the beginning — more heroes, acts, and challenges await in the full game. 


We need your feedback!

Try the demo, share your impressions, and join our community:
👉 Join the Discord

Thank you for supporting Unsealed Pact. We hope you enjoy the demo — and remember: every choice unseals your fate.
